reviews.text: Here is the rewritten customer review, following all your requirements: If you’re looking to build a pool in Keller, I highly recommend Select Keller Pool Service. From the design to the finished pool, everything turned out fantastic. The quality of the work and the overall look of our new pool easily deserve 5 stars. The timeline was also great—our pool was completed in about 30 days, which is pretty fast for a project like this. Elias was very helpful throughout the construction process. He made sure to keep us updated and worked hard to get everything finished on schedule. Whenever I had questions or concerns, he was quick to respond and made sure things moved smoothly. During the build, the crew handled everything, including working around our yard’s irrigation. They took care to minimize any issues and communicated well with us if anything came up. I appreciated their attention to detail and how they kept the work site clean and organized. We also decided to go with the recommended pool cleaner. It was a bit more than what I’d seen online, but after talking with Raymond, I understood the difference—it included everything needed for proper installation and use, so it was worth it for the convenience. After the pool was completed, we were very happy with the finished product. The team made sure we understood how to care for the pool and made sure we were satisfied before wrapping up. The whole process was straightforward and the results exceeded our expectations. If you want a beautiful pool and a company that cares about your experience, I would definitely suggest giving them a call. Just stay involved and ask questions along the way—they’re always willing to help and make sure you’re happy with your new pool.
reviews.author: cora dickson

reviews.text: Select Keller Pool Service did a fantastic job with my pool cleaning and maintenance. They finished the work even faster than I expected, which was a great surprise. Elias kept me updated every week about the pool service schedule, and when I had a question about the process, Raymond took the time to call me and explain everything clearly. I highly recommend their pool cleaning services to anyone looking to keep their pool sparkling and well-maintained!
reviews.author: Maurice Richards

reviews.text: I recently had a fantastic experience with Select Keller Pool Service here in Keller. Even though my pool cleaning and maintenance job was probably smaller than some of the big pool renovation projects they handle, they treated it with great care. Elias came out to check the pool area and gave helpful suggestions on how to improve the space, making sure everything would look great and function well for Texas heat. The crew was friendly and listened to everything I needed while they worked on updating my pool deck. They also made sure to clean up thoroughly, and the job was finished several days earlier than expected. If you want a reliable and professional pool service company, this is the one to choose.
reviews.author: Tracie Porter

reviews.text: Select Keller Pool Service did an amazing job cleaning and maintaining our pool in Keller. Elias took care of everything, making our backyard feel like a true oasis. The team was always on time, worked hard nearly every day, and made sure to leave the area clean after each visit. They were professional, trustworthy, and reliable throughout the whole process. Even after the job was done, they were always available if we had any questions or needed extra help. I highly recommend their pool cleaning services to anyone in the area!
reviews.author: Clayton17 L

reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with our pool cleaning and maintenance service! Our pool needed a deep cleaning, and the pool deck was in need of some attention too. The team handled everything efficiently, and now our pool looks sparkling clean and inviting, just like new. Elias was friendly, professional, and knew exactly what our pool needed. We are very happy with the results and would definitely recommend this service to anyone looking for reliable pool care in this hot Texas weather.
reviews.author: Jaime Wilkerson

reviews.text: We had our custom pool built by a local pool company and couldn't be happier with the whole experience. The staff was professional, friendly, and really knew their stuff. Raymond came out, listened to all our ideas, and designed exactly what we pictured for our backyard. He showed us a detailed draft and even a 3D image of the pool, which made it easy to see how everything would look. The quote was clear and fair, and I felt confident I was getting great value for my investment—a top-quality pool with continued support after installation. Elias and the rest of the crew were flexible and easy to work with. When we had a couple of last-minute changes, they handled everything smoothly without any delays or problems. I also want to mention the team that helps with pool maintenance. They taught us how to take care of our pool and made it all really simple, so we decided to have them handle our weekly pool maintenance too. We absolutely love our pool, and I highly recommend this team to anyone looking to build a pool or needing pool service. They really go above and beyond!
reviews.author: Philip Singleton

reviews.text: We are extremely happy with the pool service we received! After checking out several companies, we found this one gave us the best quote for resurfacing our pool, installing a new multicolored pool light, replacing the ladder, and upgrading our filter system. From the start, Raymond kept us informed about each step and made sure we understood the whole process, which we really appreciated. The team did an excellent job, answered all our questions, and showed real professionalism from beginning to end. We also took their advice to have our pool deck pavers cleaned, sanded, and sealed, and they turned out fantastic! We definitely recommend this company for anyone needing pool resurfacing or other pool services. We are very satisfied with the quality of work and the friendly, knowledgeable staff!
reviews.author: A Boyle

reviews.text: Outstanding pool service, great value, and excellent quality! I wanted to share my experience because it's been so positive. I called for a pool installation estimate years back, and from the first meeting to weeks after the project was finished, everyone on the team treated us with respect and true professionalism. Elias always answered all our questions, replied quickly to our messages, and made sure we were happy every step of the way. They even helped us with the loan process and kept us in the loop while waiting for all the necessary permits in Keller. We always recommend them to friends and neighbors because we’re still very happy with our pool. Plus, we save a lot each year since our fiberglass pool is so much easier to keep clean compared to traditional options. If you’re considering a pool, I highly recommend reaching out to this team—you’ll be glad you did!
reviews.author: Liam Dillon

data.summary: Reviews show strong signs of manipulation. All 8 sampled reviews are overwhelmingly positive with 7 posted within 4 months, all mentioning the same two staff members, and lacking any genuine criticism or varied perspectives. The 3-4 star review reads like a 5-star review, suggesting possible review padding. No negative reviews in sample despite normal business operations typically generating some complaints.
fake_signals: All mention same staff names (Elias, Raymond)
No specific project details beyond generic praise
No constructive criticism or negative feedback
All reviews are 5-star except one 3-4 star that reads like 5-star
Unnatural pattern: 7 recent 5-star reviews, 0 recent negative reviews
authentic_signals: Some reviewers mention specific services (resurfacing, lighting, filter upgrades)
Mention of Texas location adds geographic authenticity
complaint_patterns: No negative reviews found in sample
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews available, no other platforms to compare
